title: Duel Decks: Merfolk vs. Goblins: card flavor text

entities.name: Kellyg
entities.description: A merrow aquitect.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker whose journal records that the tides have begun to ignore the moon.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind mage who can scatter what others pull from the aether.

entities.name: Rootwater Saga
entities.description: An in-world writing describing the bitter waters and root-made maze of the Rootwater home.

entities.name: Kapsho merfolk
entities.description: Merfolk who infiltrate remote fortresses in a relentless quest for arcane knowledge.

entities.name: Sunari
entities.description: A place with a remote desert citadel infiltrated by Kapsho merfolk.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The god of the sea, who speaks of vessels that sail her waters unwelcomed.

entities.name: Flurk
entities.description: A goblin whose crude language didn't differentiate between bringing the flame and being the flame.

entities.name: Foundry Street
entities.description: A street that was the site of a riot.

entities.name: Foundry Street riot
entities.description: A riot on Foundry Street after which Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons.

entities.name: Arrester Hulbein
entities.description: An arrester who tried to ban bludgeons after the Foundry Street riot.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon, whose fiery breath can only be seen by those gifted with his eye.

entities.name: Qerk
entities.description: A goblin of the Secret Warren who believes a true warrior fights with whatever's handy.

entities.name: Secret Warren
entities.description: The goblin warren Qerk belongs to.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A group whose threats warn to leave no scraps.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin mob boss described as having a perverse charisma fueled by avarice.

entities.name: Agmand Sarv
entities.description: An Azorius hussar who assessed Krenko as highly dangerous.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild that Agmand Sarv serves as a hussar.

entities.name: Auntie Grub
entities.description: A figure of tales who discovered that fire turned a goat into something delicious.

entities.name: Rocati, Duke of Martyne
entities.description: The Duke of Martyne, who experimented with phylactery.

entities.name: Martyne
entities.description: The domain of which Rocati is Duke.

events.summary: Kapsho merfolk infiltrate fortresses as remote as the desert citadel in Sunari seeking arcane knowledge.
events.quote: Kapsho merfolk have infiltrated fortresses as remote as the desert citadel in Sunari in their relentless quest for arcane knowledge.

events.summary: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tries to ban bludgeons, which causes another riot.
events.quote: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.

events.summary: In a tale, Auntie Grub discovers that a fire has turned a goat into something delicious.
events.quote: the fire had turned the goat into something that smelled delicious.
